description_en: Initial assessment or sampling performed at the time of primary diagnosis prior to any treatment
Assessment or sample collection performed immediately before initiating a specific therapeutic regimen
Assessment or sample collection performed after completing or during a specific treatment interval
Mid-treatment assessment performed to evaluate early therapeutic response or toxicity
Routine monitoring assessment performed at defined intervals during the post-treatment period
Assessment or sampling performed upon clinical, radiological, or molecular disease recurrence or progression
The baseline reference day, typically marking the start of treatment or trial enrollment
Assessment performed approximately 3 months after baseline or treatment initiation
Assessment performed approximately 6 months after baseline or treatment initiation
Assessment performed approximately 1 year after baseline or treatment initiation
Final clinical evaluation or sampling at the completion of a patient's participation in a study or protocol
